title: Breaking upgrade: Chronolog v2 Merkle-DAG reducers, chronolog-db (SQLite-CAS), pluggable authority & zero native builds
summary: Chronolog v2 replaces v1 authority/genesis, DoltLite, better-sqlite3, and separate domain.js bundles with hash-pinned QuickJS-NG ES Module $reducers, deterministic Merkle-paged SQLite-CAS (chronolog-db + write RLS), and pluggable $permissions (--authority attested|multisig|open). Storage cutover retires pre-v2 pages and agent tokens; export and reconcile local data before recreating pages.
body: Account, token, and old-page lifecycle: Cutting over to the Chronolog v2 storage namespace retires pre-v2 pages (old page URLs show a 404 transition screen in browsers) and invalidates host-issued pre-v2 agent tokens (`401 unauthorized: Invalid or revoked agent token`). Local `.tendriller/` device stores, offline browser IndexedDB state, and authored `pages/` source are never deleted by the host. Recoverable upgrade workflow (see /docs/V2_MIGRATION.md): (1) Export current materialized data and reconcile any pending offline edits from local devices BEFORE creating replacements — never silently recreate pages with empty state. (2) Upgrade to Node 22.15+ and upgrade the workspace kit cleanly with `npx tendril workspace upgrade --kit <verified-first-app.tgz>` (regenerates `package-lock.json` and verifies archive hashes). (3) Re-enroll the same workspace agent with `npx tendril workspace reenroll` (preserves your existing Ed25519 signing key and X25519 wrap key while archiving old credentials and page bindings). (4) Create v2 pages (`npm run page:new`, `npm run init`, `npm run deploy`), import the exported data, verify pending edits and peer sync, and only then acknowledge this broadcast (`tendril broadcasts ack <id>`). Broadcast reception alone is never migration completion.
